newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICA STOCKS OFF HIGHS, DE BEERS TUMBLES.
newsitem.headline: SAFRICA STOCKS OFF HIGHS, DE BEERS TUMBLES.

text.p: 1430 GMT - South African shares end off highs, as market fails to react to better-than-expected June PPI figure and knocked by De Beers results, dealers said.
* De Beers tumbles 4.68 percent, or 800 cents, to end at 163 rand, hit by higher taxation rate in half-year ended June 30.
* Dealers say some futures play also seen, adding to the volatility seen during the day. In addition, some concern over Wall Street in afternoon trade.
* Gold shares finish flat on a dull bullion price.

* Chemicals firm Sentrachem adds 55 cents to new year high of 10.80 as jobbers buy stock on expectations U.S. chemical giant Dow Chemical Co could better its buy offer after Setrachem rejected initial one.
* NBS sees large bookover of 500,000 shares boosting turnover to 68 million rand. The share was last up 25 cents to 100 rand.
* All-shares end off 3.2 points at 7,579.9, industrials add 28.3 points to 9,267.7 and golds up 0.8 points at 1,017.1.
